description: Startup special toolkit - step-by-step playbooks drawn from the Business_Adv knowledge base (seed.py) for idea validation, funding, compliance and pitch.

playbooks.title: Validate before you build
steps: Write the problem in one sentence - who has it and how often?
Talk to 20-30 target customers; ask about current spending, not compliments.
Build the smallest paid test: landing-page waitlist, pre-order, or 3-5 pilot customers.
Track willingness to pay, repeat use and CAC vs LTV for 4 weeks.
Build full product only if strangers pay and return.
playbooks.prompt: Validate my startup idea step by step: questions to ask 20 customers, how to run a paid pilot, and what numbers prove demand. My business: {business}.

playbooks.title: Funding finder (grant first, equity later)
steps: Stage 1 - Grants (no equity): SISFS up to Rs 20L grant + Rs 50L convertible, state startup policy, BIRAC BIG for biotech.
Stage 2 - Angels/incubators: Rs 10-50L after first paying customers + deck with unit economics.
Stage 3 - Seed VC / revenue-based finance only when LTV is 3x CAC and market is large.
Avoid VC for small local businesses - use MUDRA / CGTMSE / Stand-Up India instead.
playbooks.prompt: Which grants and loans am I eligible for right now, and in what order should I apply? My business: {business}, stage: {stage}, location: {location}.

playbooks.title: Year-one compliance checklist
steps: Choose structure: sole proprietor vs LLP vs private limited (DPIIT needs Pvt Ltd / LLP).
Get DPIIT recognition on startupindia.gov.in.
PAN, TAN, GST (if over threshold / inter-state), Shops & Establishment, Udyam.
Open current account; separate personal and business money from day one.
Apply for 80-IAC tax holiday via Inter-Ministerial Board after DPIIT.
playbooks.prompt: Give me a year-one registration and compliance checklist with portals, costs and deadlines for my startup: {business} in {location}.

playbooks.title: 10-slide pitch outline
steps: Problem + who feels it (with numbers).
Your solution + live demo or screenshot.
Market size: TAM / SAM / SOM for India.
Business model: price x volume = revenue; show unit economics.
Traction: customers, revenue, retention.
Competition map and why you win.
Go-to-market: first 100 customers.
Team + hiring plan.
Ask: how much, for what, runway in months.
Contact + DPIIT / patent / GeM edge if any.
playbooks.prompt: Draft a 10-slide pitch-deck outline for my startup ({business}) with what to put on each slide and which numbers investors will question.

playbooks.title: Pricing for Indian SMEs
steps: Cost = materials + labour + overheads + transport + returns + payment fees.
Check 3 competitor prices (GeM, ONDC, local market).
Pick anchor: cheaper + faster, or premium + service.
Test 2 prices with 10 customers each before fixing.
Review monthly: if CAC rises, raise price or cut cost - never sell below unit cost.
playbooks.prompt: Help me price my product for Indian SME customers: cost-plus vs competitor vs value pricing, with a table. My costs: {business}.
